subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic read-only `routing.list` Gateway RPC and Agents > Channels binding card for per-agent channel bindings, or keep binding visibility in the existing Config/CLI surfaces?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with channel/UI ergonomics, but it adds a new core Gateway protocol and Control UI surface rather than fixing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Accept Generic Routing Visibility
options.body: Review and update the linked implementation, or a replacement, to add a current-main read-only routing summary plus focused UI and RPC tests.

options.title: Keep Existing Visibility Surfaces
options.body: Close this direction after deciding the Config view, docs, and CLI/config inspection are the supported way to inspect bindings.

options.title: Defer API Shape
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers settle the routing summary contract and ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Routing Visibility
recommendation.body: Review and update the linked implementation, or a replacement, to add a current-main read-only routing summary plus focused UI and RPC tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice primarily affects the Agents Control UI shape, and steipete is the strongest verified history signal for that panel surface.
